domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's request for leave. Central aggregate of the leave management bounded context. Owns the full lifecycle from draft through final resolution.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — request created but not yet submitted; editable by the owning employee only
SUBMITTED — request submitted for managerial review; locked for employee edits; eligible for approval or rejection
APPROVED — request approved by an authorized manager; leave balance is decremented; employee may still cancel
REJECTED — request rejected by an authorized manager; terminal state (no further transitions)
CANCELLED — request withdrawn by employee (from DRAFT or SUBMITTED) or cancelled after approval; if previously APPROVED, balance is restored; terminal state

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that governs entitlement, accrual, and approval rules. The feature scope covers annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are reserved for future expansion.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Discriminated union representing the current lifecycle state of a LeaveRequest. Drives all state-transition guards.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each LeaveType has exactly one active LeavePolicy at any time. Governs how many days an employee is entitled to, whether manager approval is required, and any notice-period constraints.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect and governs new leave requests
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; does not apply to new requests but historical references remain valid

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific LeavePolicy within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval, restored on cancellation of an approved request.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is current and usable for leave requests
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further leave of this type can be taken until the next fiscal year or accrual cycle
FROZEN — balance is temporarily locked (e.g., during payroll reconciliation); no deductions or restorations allowed

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. Owns the managerId used for approval routing. Employment status gates eligibility for leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is on extended leave or suspension; leave requests may be restricted
TERMINATED — employment has ended; no new leave requests allowed; historical data preserved

business_rules: BR-001 — Employment eligibility: Only employees with employmentStatus === 'ACTIVE' may create or submit a LeaveRequest. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are rejected at submission time.

BR-002 — State transition DRAFT → SUBMITTED: The owning employee submits the request. The request must have startDate, endDate, leaveTypeId, and employeeId populated. startDate must be >= today. endDate must be >= startDate. The corresponding LeavePolicy must be ACTIVE. If requiresManagerApproval is false on the policy, the request auto-transitions to APPROVED.

BR-003 — State transition SUBMITTED → APPROVED: Only an employee whose id matches the request employee's managerId (or a designated HR role) may approve. The approver must have employmentStatus === 'ACTIVE'. On approval: approvedBy, approvedAt are set; the employee's LeaveBalance for the matching policy and fiscal year is decremented (usedDays += dayCount, remainingDays -= dayCount). If remainingDays reaches 0, balance status transitions to EXHAUSTED.

BR-004 — State transition SUBMITTED → REJECTED: Only the employee's manager (or designated HR role) may reject. rejectedBy, rejectedAt, and rejectionReason (mandatory) are set. No balance change occurs. Terminal state.
BR-005 — State transition DRAFT → CANCELLED: The owning employee may cancel a DRAFT request. cancelledBy and cancelledAt are set. No balance impact. Terminal state.
